messages:
sophia: heads up — started bring-up for nova-13b (rotary-attn variant). getting weird KV cache behavior when context > 8k, output drifts and sometimes repeats. can someone help triage?
eli: noted. can you paste the runtime config and a short repro? also which quantization level?
sophia: running q4_0 and q8_0 variants. runtime config snippet:```yaml
model: nova-13b-rotary
quant: q4_0
kv_policy: auto
kv_cache_size_mb: 1024
rotary_mult: 1.0
batching: adaptive
```
eli: ty. quick question — is tokenization consistent between eval harness and runtime? mismatch could cause KV misalignment.
sophia: same tokenizer files used, verified checksums. sample repro request: `curl -X POST https://runtime.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"input":"<long prompt>...", "max_tokens":1024}'` — logs attached show steady kv hit rate drop after ~3k tokens:```
[2026-03-20T10:12:01Z] KV_CACHE hits=96% miss=4%
[2026-03-20T10:12:35Z] KV_CACHE hits=87% miss=13%
[2026-03-20T10:13:10Z] KV_CACHE hits=61% miss=39% (evictions spike)
[2026-03-20T10:13:45Z] generation latency increase x3, repeated tokens observed
```
kevin: that evictions spike looks like kv index overflow or incorrect stride when rotary dims differ. did model use rotary scaling or fused rotary kernels?
sophia: model export used fused rotary kernels (from export-v2). runtime selected generic rotary kernel fallback on some devices.
maria: can you repro with `RUNTIME_DEBUG_KV=1` env to dump kv indices for a few steps? small dump should show if stride jumps. also try forcing `rotary_scale=0.8` as a quick experiment.
sophia: will run both now. posting results in a sec.
infra-bot: smoke job queued: jobs/eng-ml/nova-13b-kvcache-smoke/1842206791 (owner: eli) :rocket:
eli: I can own the smoke job runs and baseline comparison. priority = P1 for now because this affects long-context SLAs.
anuj: also tag this for quantization regression tests — q4_0 sometimes reorders KV layout for perf; we should run q8_0 and float16 to compare.
sophia: quick result — with `RUNTIME_DEBUG_KV=1` we see index wrap at ~4096 entries even though kv_cache_size_mb should allow ~8k. looks like a per-shard counter overflow. dump snippet:```
step 0 idx_start=0 idx_end=1024
step 100 idx_start=1024 idx_end=2048
...
step 350 idx_start=3584 idx_end=4608 (wrap detected -> idx_start 4608 -> 0)
```
jordan: hmm could be 12-bit index assumption somewhere (4096). search for fixed bitwidth in runtime storage code. I remember a `uint12_t`-ish packing in older branch.
kevin: yep, there was a legacy packing path for tiny devices. if export flagged compatibility, runtime may have chosen compact KV layout. check model meta `kv_layout: compact_v1` vs `compact_v2`.
sophia: meta shows `kv_layout: compact_v1`.
maria: next steps: 1) force `kv_layout=compact_v2` in export and re-run smoke, 2) add test that exercises >4096 tokens for all onboarded rotary models, 3) patch runtime to detect and refuse compact_v1 on configs that request bigger caches, or auto-upgrade layout.
eli: I'll open an intake ticket with tags: `eng-ml`, `runtime`, `p1`, `kvcache` and assign to infra for a runtime patch if step 1 repros.
sophia: re-run with forced `kv_layout=compact_v2` now — posting if it clears. thanks all! :pray:
anuj: and add to quantization matrix: run q4_0/q8_0/fp16 across layout variants. we need perf + quality baseline.
infra-bot: ticket created: INF-4021 "nova-13b: kv layout overflow on long contexts" (assignee: eli)
eli: assigning smoke follow-ups to me. I'll coordinate a quick runtime fix or a rolling block for compact_v1 until we can guarantee safe indices.
sophia: updated — compact_v2 fixed the wrap, no evictions on 12k token run, quality looks stable. marking for close after infra patch.
kevin: great. add a short note in the onboarding checklist: "verify kv index capacity > expected max context and assert on compact layouts". small PR incoming.
sophia: filing the bench run artifacts and logs to the nova-13b folder now. closing thread after INF-4021 is resolved. :white_check_mark:
